title: Towel Ring, 6-Inch Diameter, Allied Brass, Oil Rubbed Bronze
body_html:
Keep hand towels within easy reach and your vanity area looking clean and intentional—backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom.

  • Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Coordinates with other Foxtrot pieces for a distinguished, heritage-inspired look
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc alternatives
  • Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Foxtrot collection

Specs

  • Product type: Towel ring
  • Diameter: 6 in
  • Overall dimensions (L x H x W): 6 x 6 x 6 in
  • Projection: 2 in
  • Material: Solid brass
  • Mounting: Wall mount, concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Included: Towel ring and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
